purpose: external, independently established comparison values; none of these numbers is fitted, tuned, or chosen after any IOTA outcome

pre_freeze_verification.rule: every value whose verified_against field is 'pending' must be checked against its cited primary source and the field replaced by the checked citation before the freeze commit; a value that cannot be verified is removed and its gate is dropped, never loosened
pre_freeze_verification.resolution: every value previously listed as pending was checked against a primary source on 2026-10-27 (VERIFICATION_LOG.md); each entry's verified_against field records the citation; sourced corrections were applied to the DK site threshold, the z26 threshold, DP_3p1 beta se and nu_perp, and the static tau spread; none of these changes affects a gate

observable_conventions.survival_probability: P(t) ~ t^(-delta): fraction of single-seed runs not absorbed by tick t
observable_conventions.mean_activity: N(t) ~ t^(theta): mean number of active units at tick t averaged over all runs, including absorbed runs as zero
observable_conventions.spreading: R2(t) ~ t^(2/z): activity-weighted mean squared distance from the seed, averaged over surviving runs
observable_conventions.dynamic_percolation_note: for dynamic isotropic percolation (the general epidemic process) the activity exponent is conventionally written eta and z equals the shortest-path dimension d_min

DP: a unique absorbing state or an absorbing set reachable with nonzero probability
no spontaneous creation of activity from an absorbing configuration
no additional conservation law coupled to the activity
no permanent memory of past activity (finite-time memory is admissible)
DyP: as DP, except that sites once active become permanently unavailable (immunization)

finite recovery memory (SIRS-type: immunity expires after a finite time) is a relevant perturbation that drives the asymptotic class to DP after a crossover; only the infinite-memory limit is DyP (arXiv:2311.06306)

permanent partial immunization (a reduced but nonzero reactivation probability, as in IOTA residual recruitment) has a richer phase diagram: a DyP transition for spreading into fresh territory, a DP transition for the reactivation process, and between them a regime in which an active front survives in fresh territory while its interior dies (Grassberger, Chate and Rousseau 1997; see literature_basis.md)
applicability_conditions.minimal_law_note: IOTA-MIN-L0 spreads only into fresh sites of a quenched site-diluted medium and never re-enters depleted sites; its static persistence bound is therefore the site-percolation threshold of the medium, and dynamic percolation is the reference class if the amplitude budget does not limit exploration
